capital.heading: Côte d’Ivoire invents the instruments others copy. Next, every child reading by ten.

register.name: Public bond offering 2025 on the regional market
register.note: More than FCFA 450 billion, above the FCFA 400 billion target
register.text: Two new bonds of five and seven years, also offered in exchange for maturing bonds, sold on the WAEMU regional market.
by: Ministry of Economy, Finance and Budget of Côte d’Ivoire

register.name: Regional gas market project (PRIME-GAS)
register.detail: Approved June 2026 · IDA · With Benin and Togo
register.text: Prepares a regional gas market: coordinated gas imports, national gas master plans, harmonised rules and infrastructure ready for private finance, which the World Bank expects to unlock about $1.5 billion of private investment and lower energy costs.

register.text: A buy-back of the most expensive commercial debt, refinanced with a cheaper, longer loan and spent on schools.

assets.heading: Five assets no balance sheet counts.

items.name: The People
items.label: Citizens, 2025
items.text: 54 in every hundred live in towns and cities; the rest live on the land they farm and fish.
items.alt: A busy market street in Abidjan, Cote d Ivoire

items.name: The Land
items.label: Of land in farms and pasture
items.text: The land that feeds the nation, and the first place a citizen dividend can be earned.
items.alt: Cocoa and cashew smallholder farms in central Cote d Ivoire

items.name: The Forest
items.label: Of land under forest
items.text: Standing forest holds the water, soil and carbon that the world will pay to keep.
items.alt: Tropical rainforest of Tai National Park, Cote d Ivoire

items.name: The Water
items.label: Renewable fresh water per person
items.text: Enough to supply every home, once it is stored, treated and piped.
items.alt: The Ebrie Lagoon at Abidjan with the city beyond

items.name: The Power
items.label: Of energy from renewables, 2021
items.text: Sun, wind, water and biomass already carry part of the load; the rest is the opportunity.
items.alt: A hydropower dam on the Bandama River, Cote d Ivoire

items.name: SODECI
items.text: The water distribution company of the Eranove group, which serves more than 2 million urban households.

items.name: Azito Energie
items.text: A gas-fired power plant near Abidjan, owned by Globeleq and IPS (WA), whose fourth phase adds 253 MW of gas and steam turbines, financed with a EUR 264 million package arranged by IFC in 2019.
